mapper.select: /* com.heeji.picket.mapper.ShowDateMapper.list */ SELECT SHOW_DATE_ID AS showDateId , SHOW_ID AS showId , SHOW_DATE AS showDate FROM SHOW_DATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND SHOW_ID = #{showId} ORDER BY SHOW_DATE ASC

/* com.heeji.picket.mapper.ShowDateMapper.info */ SELECT SD.SHOW_DATE_ID AS showDateId , SD.SHOW_ID AS showId , SD.SHOW_DATE AS showDate , S.TITLE AS title , S.PLACE AS place , S.GENRE AS genre , S.POSTER_LINK AS posterLink , S.AGE_LIMIT AS ageLimit FROM SHOW_DATE SD LEFT JOIN SHOWS S ON SD.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND SD.SHOW_DATE_ID = #{showDateId}
